_comment: What the AppImage carries besides BirdoVPN and the system libraries: the AppImage runtime (the ELF program at
the start of the .AppImage file, which mounts the rest) and the AppRun launcher, plus what linuxdeploy writes.
Owner decision 2026-10-14 (L2, review round 1). scripts/ci/fetch-appimage-tooling.mjs downloads the pinned
runtime and AppRun (refusing any other bytes) and hands them to the bundler: the runtime via linuxdeploy-plugin-
appimage's LDAI_RUNTIME_FILE (appimagetool --runtime-file; otherwise it downloads type2-runtime's moving
`continuous` build), AppRun into Tauri's tool cache. scripts/generate-appimage-notices.mjs checks the built
AppImage carries exactly this runtime and this AppRun, and lists them, the libraries the runtime links
statically and the linuxdeploy-generated files in the AppImage's notices. scripts/build-corresponding-source.mjs
mirrors the runtime's source, libfuse's and squashfuse's in each release's corresponding-source asset (LGPL-2.1
section 6: the runtime's source and build scripts let a user relink it against a modified libfuse). On a bump:
take every version below from the new runtime's build scripts at its commit (scripts/common/install-
dependencies.sh, scripts/docker/Dockerfile) and binary (`strings`), update the sha256s, and vendor the texts.

runtime.name: AppImage type2-runtime
runtime.build: built by type2-runtime's CI in an alpine:3.21 container (scripts/docker/Dockerfile) with clang 19.1.4; statically linked, static-pie

linked.name: libfuse
linked.note: its lib/ and include/, patched with type2-runtime's patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff and linked statically

apprun.name: AppImageKit AppRun
apprun.note: Tauri's mirror of AppImageKit's continuous AppRun-x86_64 (the same bytes); linuxdeploy renames it AppRun.wrapped

generated.what: the launcher script linuxdeploy writes (it runs the hook below, then AppRun.wrapped)
the environment hook the GTK plugin writes (Tauri CLI embeds its copy of linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk)
